description: This file contains implementation related to wireless access point management, particularly VAP (Virtual Access Point) handling, including creation, destruction, status, configuration, and vendor-specific callbacks. It appears to be part of a larger wireless management system, with functions for managing VAP interfaces, handling associated device statistics, and interact with external vendor modules. It also includes test hooks and mock functions for testing purposes.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_vendorCb_bssid(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP,unsigned char * buf,int bufsize,int set)
methods.description: Callback function to fill BSSID in a buffer based on access point or radio.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_vendorCb_addVapIf(T_Radio * rad _UNUSED,char * vap _UNUSED,int bufsize _UNUSED)
methods.description: Adds a VAP interface to a radio and generates BSSID if applicable.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_th_vap_createHook(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Initializes vendor data for an access point.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_destroyHook(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Frees vendor data associated with an access point.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_th_vap_createVap(amxb_bus_ctx_t * const bus_ctx,wld_th_mockVendor_t * mockVendor _UNUSED,T_Radio * radio,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a new VAP interface via a bus call and retrieves its access point object.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_status(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Returns the operational status of the access point.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_th_vap_getStationStats(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Retrieves station statistics for an access point, possibly reading from a file.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_setSSIDEnable(T_AccessPoint * pAP,bool enable,bool commit)
methods.description: Enables or disables the SSID on an access point.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_setApEnable(T_AccessPoint * pAP,bool enable,bool commit)
methods.description: Enables or disables the access point.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_enable(T_AccessPoint * pAP,int enable,int set)
methods.description: Sets the enable state of the VAP and updates FSM bits accordingly.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_ssid(T_AccessPoint * pAP,char * buf,int bufsize,int set)
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSID string of an access point.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_doFsmClean(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Clears all FSM action bits for an access point.

methods.name: wld_th_vap_vendorData_t * wld_th_vap_getVendorData(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Returns vendor-specific data for an access point.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_checkCommitAll(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Checks that all FSM actions have been committed, primarily used in testing.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_checkCommitted(T_AccessPoint * pAP,swl_mask_m commitMask)
methods.description: Checks that specific FSM actions are committed based on a mask, primarily used in testing.
